---
title: "Results"
subtitle: "Numbers of each step; the main table first, details in the tabs"
---

```{python}
import json
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import _lib as L

num, pct, M = L.fmt, lambda v: L.pct(v, 1), L.model
cfg = L.config()
opis, dobor = L.metrics("opis_danych"), L.metrics("dobor_materialow")
czasy, m41, m42, m43 = (L.metrics(n) for n in ["tagowanie_czasy", "ocena_41", "ekstrakcja_42", "frekwencje_43"])
m5, m6, m7 = (L.metrics(n) for n in ["llm_5", "pule_6", "pseudoslowa_7"])
plt.rcParams.update({"figure.dpi": 110, "axes.spines.top": False, "axes.spines.right": False, "font.size": 9})
INK, ACCENT = "#2c3e50", "#18bc9c"

key_name = lambda k: M(str(k).replace("_", "-"))   # opus_5_5 → Opus 5.5

def kv(d, headers=("Item", "Value"), sort=False):
    L.table(sorted(d.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1]) if sort else d.items(), list(headers), "lr")
```

Run `{python} L.RUN_NAME`, configuration `{python} L.NAME`. Every number is read from a metrics file saved by the
pipeline ([raw files](reproduce.qmd#raw-metrics-files)). What each step does: [Method](method.qmd).

## 2 · Lemmatisation {#tagging}

```{python}
tools = m41.get("narzedzia", {})
prod = cfg["narzedzia"]["tager_produkcyjny"]
tname = {"spacy": "spaCy", "stanza": "Stanza", "spacy_morfeusz": "spaCy + Morfeusz2", "stanza_morfeusz": "Stanza + Morfeusz2",
         "morfeusz_pierwsza": "Morfeusz2, first reading", "llm_haiku_5_5": "Haiku 5.5", "llm_sonnet_5_5": "Sonnet 5.5"}
nm = lambda t: tname.get(t, t)
acc = lambda t: tools.get(t, {}).get("lemat_dokladny_wszystkie")
best = max(tools, key=lambda t: acc(t) or 0) if tools else None
L.md(f"**Finding:** adding Morfeusz2 raises exact-match accuracy of spaCy from {num(acc('spacy'))} to {num(acc('spacy_morfeusz'))}. "
     f"The best tool is {nm(best)} with {num(acc(best))}; the tagger used for the whole corpus is {nm(prod)} with {num(acc(prod))}"
     + (", which runs locally and costs nothing." if str(best).startswith("llm_") and best != prod else "."))
```

```{python}
#| fig-cap: "Share of forms whose base form equals the reference (tagger used for the corpus in green)."
#| fig-alt: "Horizontal bar chart of exact-match lemmatisation accuracy by tool."
order = sorted(tools, key=lambda t: acc(t) or 0)
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6.2, 2.6))
bars = ax.barh([nm(t) for t in order], [acc(t) or 0 for t in order], color=[ACCENT if t == prod else INK for t in order])
ax.bar_label(bars, fmt="%.2f", padding=3)
ax.set_xlim(0, 1); ax.set_xlabel(f"exact match, {num(m41.get('n'))} forms")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
```

::: {.callout-warning title="The reference is provisional"}
`{python} "The sheet has been checked by a human." if m41.get("referencja_ludzka_z_arkusza") else "No human has checked the sheet yet."`
The reference is the base form written by ZPE editors where one exists, otherwise an answer from
`{python} M(cfg["llm"].get("lematyzacja_referencja"))`, which may favour the LLM lemmatisers.
:::

::: {.panel-tabset}

#### All scores

```{python}
strata = sorted({k.split("__")[1] for d in tools.values() for k in d if k.startswith("lemat_dokladny__")})

n_zpe = next((d.get("n_ref_redakcja_ZPE") for d in tools.values()), None)
rows = [(nm(t), d.get("lemat_dokladny_wszystkie"), d.get("lemat_skladniki_wszystkie"), d.get("lemat_dokladny_ref_redakcja_ZPE"),
         *[d.get(f"lemat_dokladny__{s}") for s in strata]) for t, d in tools.items()]
L.table(sorted(rows, key=lambda r: -(r[1] or 0)),
        ["Tool", "Exact", "Components", f"Exact, ZPE editors' reference (n = {n_zpe})", *[f"Exact, {st_lab.get(s, s)}" for s in strata]])
L.md("*Exact*: the whole base form equals the reference. *Components*: every word of the answer has the right lemma, "
     "even if the phrase was not rebuilt in the nominative.")
```

## 3 · General-frequency resources {#frequency}

```{python}
res = {"kwjp": "KWJP100", "nkjp1m": "NKJP 1M subcorpus", "subtlex": "SUBTLEX-PL (comparison only, non-commercial licence)", "wordfreq": "wordfreq"}
pl = m43.get("pokrycie_lematow_cel", {})
cov = {k: v for k, v in pl.items() if k != "n"}
top = max(cov, key=cov.get) if cov else None
L.md(f"**Finding:** {res.get(top, top)} covers the largest share of the {num(pl.get('n'))} distinct biology lemmas ({pct(cov.get(top))}). "
     "The lists use KWJP100 (CC BY 4.0).")
L.table([(res.get(k, k), pct(v)) for k, v in sorted(cov.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1])], ["Resource", "Biology lemmas covered"], "lr")
```

```{python}
co = m43.get("korelacje_rang_lematy_biol_freq_cel_ge_3", {})

L.table(rows, ["Pair", "Spearman ρ of frequencies", "Lemmas"])
```

## 4 · Candidates {#extraction}

```{python}
L.table([("Subject candidates", m42.get("n_kandydatow")), ("… single words", m42.get("n_jednowyrazowych")), ("… multiword", m42.get("n_mwu")),
         ("General candidates not among them", m42.get("n_kandydatow_ogolnych_tylko"))], ["Measure", "Value"])
```

### Which score finds terms best

```{python}
mv = m5.get("metody_wzgledem_etykiet_llm", {})
mlab = {"ll_kontrast": "log-likelihood vs contrast", "log_ratio_kontrast": "log ratio vs contrast",
        "simple_maths_kwjp": "Simple Maths vs KWJP100", "ll_kwjp": "log-likelihood vs KWJP100", "tfidf_biol": "TF-IDF across subjects",
        "pmi_mwu": "PMI (multiword)", "logdice_mwu": "logDice (multiword)", "cvalue_termopl": "C-value (TermoPL)",
        "rrf": "rank fusion of all scores", "frekwencja_cel": "frequency in biology alone"}
p300 = {m: (d.get("wszystkie") or {}).get("p@300") for m, d in mv.items() if m != "poziom_odniesienia"}
p300 = {m: v for m, v in p300.items() if v is not None}
b0 = mv.get("poziom_odniesienia", {}).get("wszystkie")
if p300:
    top2 = sorted(p300, key=p300.get, reverse=True)[:2]
    L.md(f"**Finding:** of the top 300 candidates of each score, the share finally labelled T3 is highest for "
         f"{mlab[top2[0]]} ({num(p300[top2[0]])}) and {mlab[top2[1]]} ({num(p300[top2[1]])}); frequency alone gives "
         f"{num(p300.get('frekwencja_cel'))}, and {num(b0)} of all candidates are T3.")
```

```{python}
#| fig-cap: "Share of the top 300 candidates of each score that the models labelled T3 (line: share of T3 among all candidates)."
#| fig-alt: "Horizontal bar chart of precision at 300 by extraction score, with the share of T3 among all candidates as a vertical line."
rows = sorted(p300.items(), key=lambda x: x[1])
if rows:
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6.4, 0.32 * len(rows) + 1))
    bars = ax.barh([mlab.get(m, m) for m, _ in rows], [v for _, v in rows], color=INK)
    ax.bar_label(bars, fmt="%.2f", padding=3)
    if b0:
        ax.axvline(b0, color=ACCENT, lw=1.5)
    ax.set_xlim(0, 1); ax.set_xlabel("P@300 against the final T3 label")
    plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
```

The T3 labels come from the models of step 5, not from people.

```{python}
univ = {"wszystkie": "All candidates", "jednowyrazowe": "Single words", "wielowyrazowe": "Multiword"}
prec, base = m42.get("precyzja_wzgledem_srebrnego", {}), m42.get("precyzja_poziom_odniesienia", {})
heads = ["Score", "Candidates ranked", "P@100", "P@300", "P@1000", "R@100", "R@300", "R@1000"]
parts = ["::: {.panel-tabset}"]
for u, title in univ.items():
    rows = [("*share of T3 among candidates*", "", *[mv.get("poziom_odniesienia", {}).get(u)] * 3, "", "", "")]
    for m, d in mv.items():
        x = d.get(u) if m != "poziom_odniesienia" else None
        if x:
            rows.append((mlab.get(m, m), x.get("n_ranking"), *[x.get(f"{a}@{k}") for a in "pr" for k in (100, 300, 1000)]))
    parts += [f"#### {title}", L.table_md(rows, heads)]
rows = [("*share of glossary entries among candidates*", "", *[base.get("wszystkie", {}).get("vs_union")] * 3, "", "", "")]
for m, d in prec.items():
    x = (d.get("wszystkie") or {}).get("vs_union")
    if x:
        rows.append((mlab.get(m, m), x.get("n_ranking"), *[x.get(f"{a}@{k}") for a in "pr" for k in (100, 300, 1000)]))
cv = (m42.get("srebrny_pokrycie") or {}).get("slowniczek", {})
parts += ["#### Against ZPE glossaries", L.table_md(rows, heads),
          f"All candidates. The glossaries hold only what editors chose to explain, so low precision here does not mean wrong "
          f"candidates. {num(cv.get('wsrod_kandydatow_po_progach'))} of {num(cv.get('hasla'))} glossary entries "
          f"({pct(cv.get('udzial_wsrod_kandydatow'))}) are among the candidates; the others fall below the frequency thresholds."]
L.md("\n\n".join(parts + [":::"]))
```

P@K: share of the top K that is a term. R@K: share of all terms among the candidates reached by K.

## 5 · Labels {#llm}

```{python}
mod, ag = m5.get("modele", {}), m5.get("zgodnosc_miedzy_modelami", {})
a_name, b_name = (M(x) for x in (mod.get("porownywane") or ["–", "–"])[:2])
judge = M(mod.get("rozstrzygajacy"))
js = m5.get("rozstrzygniecia", {})
L.md(f"**Finding:** {a_name} and {b_name} give the same label to {pct(ag.get('prosta'))} of candidates (Cohen's κ {num(ag.get('kappa'))}). "
     f"{judge} settled {num(m5.get('n_rozstrzyganych'))} cases; {num(m5.get('n_do_przegladu'))} had no majority and are marked for review.")
cat = {"T3": "T3 · biology term", "T3_INNY": "T3_INNY · term of another subject", "T2": "T2 · school vocabulary",
       "T1": "T1 · everyday word", "SZUM": "SZUM · not usable"}
fa, fs, fg = (m5.get(k, {}) for k in ("rozklad_final", "rozklad_final_przedmiotowe", "rozklad_final_tylko_ogolne"))
L.table([(cat[k], fa.get(k, 0), fs.get(k, 0), fg.get(k, 0)) for k in cat]
        + [("**Labelled in total**", m5.get("n_klasyfikowanych"), m5.get("n_klasyfikowanych_przedmiotowych"), m5.get("n_klasyfikowanych_ogolnych"))],
        ["Final label", "All", "Subject candidates", "General candidates"])
```

::: {.callout-warning title="Agreement is not accuracy"}
No human labels exist yet. Once the [worksheet](sheets.qmd) is filled in, step 6 reports precision and recall
against it.
:::

### Check: terms listed by a model directly from the materials

```{python}
ex = m5.get("ekstrakcja_llm", {})
if ex.get("n_terminow"):
    L.md(f"**Finding:** {M(ex.get('model'))} read {num(ex.get('n_materialow'))} biology materials and listed "
         f"{num(ex.get('n_terminow_T3'))} biology terms. Step 4 has {pct(ex.get('T3_wsrod_kandydatow'))} of them among its candidates: "
         f"{pct(ex.get('T3_jednowyrazowe_wsrod_kandydatow'))} of the single words and {pct(ex.get('T3_wielowyrazowe_wsrod_kandydatow'))} "
         "of the multiword terms. The others occur too rarely in the sample or do not fit the phrase patterns; they are listed "
         "on the [Pools](pools.qmd) page.")
else:
    L.md("Not run.")
```

### Cost

```{python}
m8k = L.metrics("koszty_8") or {"wg_zadania": m5.get("koszty_usd_wg_zadania", {}), "dotychczas": m5.get("koszt_usd_dotychczas")}
by_model = {}
for kk, vv in (m8k.get("wg_zadania") or {}).items():
    by_model[M(kk.split(" / ")[-1])] = by_model.get(M(kk.split(" / ")[-1]), 0) + vv
L.table([(k, f"{v:.2f}") for k, v in sorted(by_model.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1])] + [("**Total**", f"**{m8k.get('dotychczas') or 0:.2f}**")],
        ["Model", "USD"], "lr")
```

#### Matching by word type

```{python}
st = {"rzeczownik": "nouns", "przymiotnik": "adjectives", "czasownik": "verbs", "przysłówek": "adverbs", "inne": "other single words",
      "fraza 2": "two-word phrases", "fraza 3": "phrases of three or more words"}
L.table([(st.get(k, k), d.get("terminy"), d.get("pula_ogolna"), d.get("dopasowane"), L.pct(d.get("udzial")))
         for k, d in sorted(dp.get("wg_warstwy", {}).items(), key=lambda x: -x[1].get("terminy", 0))],
        ["Type", "Subject terms", "General items available", "Matched", "Share"])
ph = [d for k, d in dp.get("wg_warstwy", {}).items() if k.startswith("fraza")]
L.md(f"The general pool has {num(sum(d.get('pula_ogolna', 0) for d in ph))} phrases for {num(sum(d.get('terminy', 0) for d in ph))} "
     "multiword terms, so most multiword terms stay without a partner.")
```

#### Parts of speech

```{python}
pos = {"rzeczownik": "noun", "przymiotnik": "adjective", "czasownik": "verb", "przysłówek": "adverb", "fraza": "multiword", "inne": "other"}
a, b = m6.get("pula_przedmiotowa_pos", {}), m6.get("pula_ogolna_pos", {})
L.table([(pos.get(k, k), a.get(k, 0), b.get(k, 0)) for k in sorted(set(a) | set(b), key=lambda k: -(a.get(k, 0) + b.get(k, 0)))],
        ["Part of speech", "Subject pool", "General pool"])
```

## 7 · Pseudowords {#pseudowords}

```{python}
wm = m7.get("wg_metody", {})
gname = {"llm": f"`llm` ({M(m7.get('model_generujacy'))})"}
if wm:
    topg = max(wm, key=lambda g: wm[g].get("wybrane") or 0)
    L.md(f"**Finding:** {num(m7.get('n_wygenerowanych'))} candidates → {num(m7.get('n_zaakceptowanych'))} passed the filters → "
         f"{num(m7.get('n_ocena_pozytywna'))} of {num(m7.get('n_ocenianych'))} rated ones were rated positively → "
         f"{num(m7.get('n_wybranych'))} recommended, for {num(m7.get('n_szablonow_z_wybranym'))} of {num(m7.get('n_szablonow'))} templates. "
         f"{gname.get(topg, f'`{topg}`')} supplies {num(wm[topg].get('wybrane'))} of the recommended ones.")
rows = [(gname.get(g, f"`{g}`"), d.get("wygenerowane"), d.get("przyjete"), L.pct(d.get("udzial_przyjetych")), d.get("oceniane"),
         L.pct(d.get("udzial_pozytywnych")), d.get("srednia_wymawialnosc"), d.get("wybrane")) for g, d in wm.items()]
L.table(rows, ["Generator", "Generated", "Passed the filters", "… share", "Rated", "Rated positively", "Pronounceability (1–5)", "Recommended"])
```

::: {.panel-tabset}

#### Rejection reasons

```{python}
why = {"znaki_spoza_alfabetu": "characters outside the alphabet", "istniejace_slowo": "existing word",
       "ksztalt_niezgodny_ze_wzorcem": "length, syllables or ending differ from the template",
       "za_blisko_wzorca": "one letter from the template", "ortotaktyka": "untypical letter pattern",
       "literowka_czestego_slowa": "one edit from a frequent word", "homofon": "sounds like an existing word",
       "przejrzysta_budowa": "existing stem with an affix, or a compound", "skojarzenie_wulgarne": "vulgar association",
       "slowo_ukrainskie_lub_rosyjskie": "Ukrainian or Russian word"}
reasons, meths = list(m7.get("odrzucenia_powody", {})), list(wm)
L.table([(why.get(r, r), m7["odrzucenia_powody"][r], *[wm[g].get("powody", {}).get(r, 0) for g in meths]) for r in reasons],
        ["First filter failed", "All", *[f"`{g}`" for g in meths]])
```

#### Do pseudowords look like the real words

```{python}
ro = m7.get("rozklady", [])
feat = {"dlugosc": "Length in letters", "syl": "Syllables", "zbitka": "Longest consonant run", "diakryty": "Diacritic letters",
        "old20": "OLD20 (higher = fewer similar words)", "bigram_lp": "Mean log bigram probability"}
g = {(r["grupa"], r["cecha"]): r for r in ro} if isinstance(ro, list) else {}
L.table([(f, g.get(("szablony", k), {}).get("srednia"), g.get(("pseudoslowa_wybrane", k), {}).get("srednia"),
          g.get(("pseudoslowa_wybrane", k), {}).get("smd_wzgledem_szablonow")) for k, f in feat.items()],
        ["Feature", "Templates (real words), mean", "Recommended pseudowords, mean", "Standardised difference"])
far = [(f, g.get(("pseudoslowa_wybrane", k), {}).get("smd_wzgledem_szablonow")) for k, f in feat.items()]
far = [(f.split(" (")[0], v) for f, v in far if v is not None and abs(v) >= 0.2]
L.md("Values near 0 in the last column mean a pupil cannot tell words from pseudowords by that feature. "
     + ("Still different: " + ", ".join(f"{f} ({num(v)})" for f, v in far) + "." if far else "No feature differs by 0.2 or more."))
```
